country.name: France
country.regulator: Jeux-concours and loteries publicitaires must be free to enter (or the cost refundable) under the Code de la consommation. Gambling is regulated by the ANJ (Autorité nationale des jeux).
country.eligibility: Usually residents of metropolitan France aged 18+ (some include Belgium/Switzerland or the DROM); check the règlement.
tips: A genuine jeu-concours names the organiser and has a règlement (rules) you can read.
You never pay 'frais de dossier', call a surcharged number or give card details to claim a prize.
Be careful with 'vous avez gagné' emails and SMS for games you didn't enter.
country.paid_note: Paid lotteries are restricted in France (ANJ)
